html.content:
Recommended

Dotplotscore: 0.35

Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.

Clinical use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts

  • small n — show every point

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'

It can display individual data points for categorical

Alternatives

Ridgelinescore: 0.4

Stacked density plots per group — compare distributions without overlap.

Clinical use: Lab distributions across multiple visits or arms

  • several groups to compare
  • 4+ groups → ridgeline avoids overlapping color curves

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='ridgeline plot of <numeric> by <factor>'

Upsetscore: 0.4

UpSet plot — scalable alternative to Venn for many sets.

Clinical use: Multi-way AE overlap, multi-drug co-occurrence

  • 2+ cats → set membership

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='UpSet plot of set intersections across <factors>'

TreeBracketscore: 0.35

Tree/dendrogram with bracket annotations.

Clinical use: Hierarchical clustering of samples or genes

  • category labels → dendrogram leaves

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='tree bracket dendrogram of <factor>'

Networkscore: 0.3

Nodes and edges for relational or pathway data.

Clinical use: Pathway enrichment, protein-protein interaction

  • 2 cats — possible node/edge pairs

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='network graph of pathways'
